how: Expose model registration state through supported CLI/API surfaces and preserve enough metadata for downstream consumers to reason about compatibility.
how_not: Do not require callers to scrape YAML indexes directly or infer registration state from incidental filesystem details.
title: Model registration must be queryable
what: Registered model state should be inspectable through explicit SLDB commands and APIs rather than by forcing downstream tools to read store files directly.
when: Apply this pill when changing model registration, list/check surfaces, or recovery tooling.
where:
- `src/sldb/cli/commands/models.py`
- store model indexes
- deskops recovery and health integrations
why: Deskops and operators need to detect missing, stale, or incompatible model registrations without coupling to raw store layout.
